/* isry.csemd.cmmn.mapper.CsemdMapper - selectBizYr */ /* Lee SangHoon [드림/디딤 사업연도 콤보데이터 호출] */
SELECT DISTINCT A.BIZ_YR /* 사업연도 */ FROM SDA400 A /* 서비스사업 */ LEFT JOIN SDA420 B /* 서비스실행사업 */ ON A.SRVC_BIZ_NO = B.SRVC_BIZ_NO
WHERE 1=1 AND A.UNT_TASKWK_SE_CD = #{UNT_TASKWK_SE_CD} AND (B.INST_NO = #{INST_NO} OR #{INST_TYPE_SE_CD} < '5' OR #{AUTHRT_SE_CD} = '3300706' OR SUBSTR(#{AUTHRT_SE_CD},2,2) = '10')
ORDER BY A.BIZ_YR DESC

/*SQL-ID : isry.csemd.cmmn.mapper.CsemdMapper selectSrvcExcnBizCmb : 과정(서비스실행사업) select box data 리스트 */
SELECT DISTINCT A.SRVC_EXCN_BIZ_NM /* 서비스실행사업명 */ ,A.INST_NO /* 기관번호*/ ,A.SRVC_EXCN_BIZ_NO /* 서비스실행사업번호 */ ,A.BIZ_BGNG_YMD AS SRVC_EXCN_BIZ_BGNG_YMD /* 서비스실행사업시작일자 */ ,A.BIZ_END_YMD AS SRVC_EXCN_BIZ_END_YMD /* 서비스실행사업사업종료일자 */ ,B.BIZ_YR /* 사업연도 */ ,A.ALTMNT_GROUP_LCLAS_SE_CD /* 배정그룹대분류구분코드 */ ,B.ALTMNT_GROUP_PRD_CL_SE_CD /* 배정그룹기간분류구분코드 */ ,A.REQSTD_INDCT_YN /* 신청서표시여부 */ FROM SDA420 A /* 서비스실행사업 */ LEFT JOIN SDA400 B /* 서비스사업 */ ON A.SRVC_BIZ_NO = B.SRVC_BIZ_NO
WHERE 1=1 AND B.UNT_TASKWK_SE_CD = #{UNT_TASKWK_SE_CD} /* 단위업무구분코드 */ AND (A.INST_NO = #{INST_NO} OR #{INST_TYPE_SE_CD} < '5' OR #{AUTHRT_SE_CD} = '3300706' OR SUBSTR(#{AUTHRT_SE_CD},2,2) = '10') /* 기관번호 */
ORDER BY A.BIZ_BGNG_YMD, A.SRVC_EXCN_BIZ_NM
